checkRuns.command: bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -5; git status --short; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -30

cat > src/routes/_layout.kay <<'EOF' --- server import { books } from '../content.config' const [, section, slug, ...rest] = ctx.url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '').split('/') const inBooks = section === 'books' && rest.length === 0 && (slug === undefined || (await books.get(decodeURIComponent(slug))) !== undefined) const current = (name: string) => ((name === 'books' ? inBooks : section === name && slug === undefined) ? 'page' : undefined) --- header a(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf nav(aria-label="Main") a(href="/books" aria-current={current('books')}) Books a(href="/about" aria-current={current('about')}) About a(href="/contact" aria-current={current('contact')}) Contact main slot footer © Bookshelf EOF bun run check 2>&1 | tail; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books | grep -o '
    .*
'

kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "kay start"; sleep 1; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warn|rendered" ; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 & sleep 2 for p in /books /books/dracula /books/nope /nope /about/x; do echo "$p: $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701$p | grep -o '')"; done A=http://127.0.0.1:4701/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/contact echo "== invalid"; curl -s -i -X POST "$A" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact" -F name=" " -F email="bad@x" -F message="short" | grep -oE '^HTTP.*|' echo "== valid"; curl -s -i -c /tmp/cj -X POST "$A" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact" -F name=" Ada " -F email="ada@example.com" -F message="This is a long enough message." | grep -iE '^HTTP|^location|
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4701/ ; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warn" ; echo built

kill $(cat /tmp/kay.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pgrep -af "kay" | grep -v pgrep; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4701/; bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|^Routes" ; echo "build exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
